manifest.name: ELIZA-µ
manifest.description: Conversational pattern engine with field-biased routing via eliza-bias.gml — classifies input to a field (⟁GENERAL_QA, ⟁REFLECTION, ⟁CONVERSATION, ⟁KNOWLEDGE, ⟁REASONING, ⟁FALLBACK) and applies eliza-bias.gml default_bias weights to rank AIML candidates before selection.

driver_roles.Field.Patterns.dll: field routing via eliza-bias.gml and eliza-field.sources.json
driver_roles.ELIZA.Patterns.dll: AIML pattern matching, synonym collapse, and response shaping

eliza.bank.description: Pop-phase pattern dispatch: synonym_collapse → manifest_lookup → field-scoped find_best_pattern_match
eliza.bank.note: Pattern pool is narrowed to the active field before ranking

eliza.field.description: Wo-phase field classifier and bias ranker: routes input to one of 6 fields using eliza-field.sources.json dynamic bindings, then applies eliza-bias.gml default_bias to score AIML candidates within that field

eliza.rule.description: Yax-phase field rule evaluation: checks predicate rules from eliza-field.sources.json#rules (e.g. reflection.feeling bias adjustment when capture contains SAD), applies then/else branch and default_bias multiplier

eliza.operator.description: Pop/Sek-phase ELIZA-1 reasoning operator detection: 16 operators (CAUSE, CONTRAST, DEPENDENCY, CONSTRAINT, EVIDENCE, SEQUENCE, BOUNDARY, STATE, CONFLICT, ALTERNATIVE, INVARIANT, TEST, RELATION, SUBSTITUTE, VERIFY, DIRECT) detected at Pop, emitted as directive at Sek

eliza.srai.description: Ch'en-phase SRAI bridge: wraps eliza.srai.bridge block — receives Ch'en accumulator from eliza.rule, detects <srai> in candidate template, delegates to aiml.srai.vector for chain resolution if present, emits typed routing proposal for XCFE admission. Turns ELIZA into a reusable semantic operator in K'UHUL Atomic workflows.

eliza.reflect.description: Xul-phase emit: applies field-bias-ranked candidate template, fills wildcard captures, writes response to gram store under ELIZA namespace. MUST NOT execute unless eliza.srai routing_proposal status is xcfe_admitted.

eliza.health.description: Pop-phase diagnostic: reports active field, top candidate scores, bias weights, operator coverage, pattern_registry size, and synonym_collapse stats

pair_constraint.note: PROOF_001: template_fill fold MUST NOT emit unless a matched candidate was found in the active field
